title: Specializing Meta Multi-Objectivization as Baseline for Software Engineering Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.12991v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Given the discrete nature of many software engineering (SE) optimization problems, trapping at local optima remains a crucial issue in the optimizer designs. Meta Multi-Objectivization (MMO) is an optimization model for overcoming local optima by introducing an extra, auxiliary objective. Yet, MMO is originally designed only for configuration tuning, leaving its suitability for other SE problems in doubt, particularly regarding the choice of the auxiliary objective. In this paper, we study the possibility and resolution for specializing MMO as a general baseline across a range of SE optimization problems, making it a fundamental counterpart for future SE optimizers that seek to mitigate the issue of local optima. We do so by providing both theoretical remit and empirical evidence: we analytically show how the choice of the auxiliary objective is crucial while demonstrating the effectiveness of MMO under nine SE optimization problems co

translated_title: 将元多目标化专门化为软件工程优化的基线方法
translated_abstract: 鉴于许多软件工程（SE）优化问题的离散特性，陷入局部最优仍然是优化器设计中的一个关键问题。元多目标化是一种通过引入额外的辅助目标来克服局部最优的优化模型。然而，MMO最初仅为配置调优而设计，其对于其他软件工程问题的适用性尚存疑问，特别是关于辅助目标的选择。在本文中，我们研究了将MMO专门化为一系列软件工程优化问题的通用基线的可能性与解决方案，使其成为未来寻求缓解局部最优问题的软件工程优化器的基础对应方法。我们通过提供理论依据和实证证据来实现这一目标：我们通过分析展示了辅助目标的选择如何至关重要，同时证明了MMO在九个软件工程优化问题上的有效性……
tldr: 本文将元多目标化（MMO）从仅适用于配置调优的模型专门化为软件工程优化的通用基线，通过理论分析和九个软件工程优化问题的实证研究，阐明了辅助目标选择的关键性并验证了MMO克服局部最优的有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper specializes Meta Multi-Objectivization (MMO), originally designed only for configuration tuning, into a general baseline for software engineering optimization, analytically demonstrating the criticality of auxiliary objective choice and empirically validating MMO's effectiveness across nine SE optimization problems.
